answer_1.quote: We propose a unified framework to generate both homographic and heterographic puns; examples shown here are human-written puns from our corpus.

answer_2.quote: We report pun word incorporation rate as the automatic evaluation metric to measure the model's ability to incorporate pun words in the final generation.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk to judge whether the generated puns are successful.
answer_4.guideline: We asked annotators to indicate whether they can come up with a pun, using pun pair (p w , a w ), that is situated in a given context C and supports both senses S pw and S aw .
